Delivers: The reports page downloads on-demand CSV exports with every table column and bounded paging. ACs 1, 2, 4; 3, 5 deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46; 4's observable half (export completes under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so paging fixes must be maintained in two places. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Verdict: mergeable - CI green on the assessed head (test)

1. merge - squash the assessed head into the base branch [recommended]
2. show evidence - show the CI evidence, claim and AC outcomes, and drafted nit
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available in this fixture).

### Selected pick: merge

The variables below refer to the assessed SHA, worktree, and helper output paths recorded in steps 1-4; their values are not supplied in the fixture.

Before merging, recheck the assessed state, refresh both comment collections, and confirm the worktree is clean and at the assessed head:

```bash
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json headRefOid,state,mergeable
gh api repos/acme/widgets/pulls/210/comments --paginate
gh api repos/acme/widgets/issues/210/comments --paginate
git -C "$worktree" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD
```

A changed head, state, or mergeability requires reassessment. A new or changed-body comment aborts this merge pick for source review and a fresh selection.

With those preconditions satisfied, execute the merge and read its result:

```bash
gh pr merge 210 -R acme/widgets --squash --match-head-commit "$assessed_sha"
gh pr view 210 -R acme/widgets --json state,mergeCommit
```

The fixture supplies a successful merge result. No review, reply, or coverage comment is posted by this pick.

## AC coverage

Informational - the ticket's rows are unchanged. PR https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/210, merged 9f1c2d3e4b5a6978, spec doc/specs/2026-09-30-csv-export.md

- [ ] AC2 The export includes every column shown in the table. - covered
- [ ] AC3 Exports are emailed to the requesting user. - deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46
- [ ] AC4 The export completes under 5s on production data. - covered
- [ ] AC5 Export events appear in the audit log. - deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46

1. post coverage to ticket - comment the block above on acme/widgets#45
2. post coverage to PR - comment the block above on the PR
3. show evidence - show the gate evidence and drafted payloads
4. stop - leave the PR as-is [recommended]

Type a number.

### Selected reply: stop

No coverage comment is posted. Because this gate merged the PR, teardown removes the provisioned worktree and this run's helper output files:

```bash
git worktree remove "$worktree"
rm -f -- "$verify_output" "$review_output"
```

There are no local verification logs to delete because verification used CI. Unapplied drafted payloads are dropped, and the merged PR remains unchanged.

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The first screen is decidable: a row-naming Delivers clause, one nit, a single verdict line and a numbered merge menu; the post-merge coverage menu recommends stop, and the stop reply posts nothing.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The post-merge menu and stop outcome satisfy the facts, but preliminary merge instructions and implementation details bury the relevant decision.
